detail.longDescription: I've been asked by a few of you to put something together on how I built my private media streamer, so here it is. The nuts and bolts of how you can disrupt a several hundred billion dollar industry for about $1,000 and an afternoon on the workbench. three Pi 5s, Plex, the arr stack, an encrypted rclone cloud library, and WireGuard. https:// ryanthomashuff.com/raspberry-p i-plex-server-family-streaming-stack/ # HomeLab # RaspberryPi # Plex # SelfHosted
